title: Interlocking Tiling of 3D Finite Domains
abstract: A K-hedral tiling of a 3D finite domain is a covering of the domain with tiles without gaps or overlaps, where each tile is congruent to one of the K distinct shapes called prototiles. To use 3D K-hedral tilings in practice, they need to satisfy two requirements. First, K should be small to reduce the fabrication cost (e.g., through reusable molds) and simplify the (dis)assembly process. Second, a K-hedral tiling result should be structurally stable, in particular via interlocking, where all the tiles are immobilized by their geometric arrangement, except the key. Since these two requirements are often in conflict, existing approaches always trade one for the other. In this work, we formulate a new tiling problem called interlocking tiling, aiming to generate 3D K-hedral tilings that satisfy the above two requirements simultaneously. Given a 3D finite domain represented as a voxel grid, our goal is to compute a small prototile set whose instances exactly tile the input domain while ensuring that the tiling result forms an interlocking assembly. To solve this challenging problem, we propose a twolevel computational approach that hierarchically decomposes the input domain into interlocking parts (domain-level partitioning) and further partitions each part into interlocking tiles (part-level partitioning). To guide the part-level partitioning, we propose a new graph representation with regular structures to facilitate the generation of tiles with identical shapes while ensuring that they are interlocking. Our approach allows generating interlocking tilings that exactly cover 3D finite domains with diverse shapes while achieving high prototile reuse. We compared our approach with state-of-the-art methods to demonstrate its superiority, and validated the practicality of our interlocking tiling results via fabricating two of them.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据精确 arXiv 版本 2611.20401v1 的 12 页全文及关键图表整理。实验数字为作者报告。
analysis.ideaZh: 用两层 directional blocking graph 将给定体素域先切成互锁大件，再切成互锁小块。通过重复局部图构造复用 prototiles，并同时保证无缝覆盖与单 key 拆卸。作者展示了两件实物，但未建模连接应力。
analysis.motivationZh: 对同一目标域同时控制块种类数和几何互锁，降低重复制造成本。
analysis.methodZh: 用两级分割与规则 IT-DBG 指定方向阻挡关系，再逐边构造体素接触并分配剩余空间。
methodFlow: 给定待铺砌体素域和目标块数
域级分割为互锁大件并确定解锁次序
构造规则方向阻挡图并拼接子图
用锚点和体素连接实现边并分配剩余体素
输出复用形块及分层装拆顺序
analysis.experimentsZh: 以多个体素结构测试铺砌数量、形块复用和构造耗时，审查两层和单层解。比较 forward interlocking-voxel 方案和 inverse DESIA；另有 Box 和 Stool 两个打印实例。 作者报告同一输入下 DESIA 生成 472 个互不相同的块，其方案只需 14 种形块（§VII, Fig. 15, PDF p. 10）。 作者报告实际块数与目标数相差小于 10%；Fig. 1 的一例由 21 种形块的 671 个实例铺满（§VII, Table I, PDF pp. 8–9; Fig. 1, PDF p. 2）。 作者报告打印盒能够提起约 15 kg 书籍，凳子可承载一位约 90 kg 的受试者（§VII, Fig. 13, PDF p. 10）。 包含两种目标不同的代表性几何方案，未提供与所有同规模复杂形状的材料应力或公差比较。 Table I、Fig. 8 和 Fig. 11 分别报告不同域和层级构造案例。论文没有独立控制图规则、分层和几何实现贡献的消融。
analysis.insightZh: 把 inverse 输入形状约束下的精确铺砌与 regular blocking graph 的形块复用结合，输出几何覆盖和互锁可共同审查。
analysis.evidenceZh: 两级分解分别约束域级 key part 和 part 级 key tile（§§III–IV, Fig. 3, PDF p. 3）。每一级的互锁条件都通过可拆移动建立。 规则 IT-DBG 支持重复拓扑，连接子图后再落实为体素阻挡与填充（§§V–VI, Figs. 6–7, PDF pp. 5–7）。子图实现体现连接条件与形块重复的关系。 重复形状与互锁一起得到物理展示（§VII, Figs. 13–15, PDF p. 10）。两件原型是示例级实体证据，不代表通用承载等级。 体素域必须有足够内部空间且连接应力待建模（§VIII, Limitation and future work, PDF p. 11）。限制了细薄结构以及大型工程应用。
analysis.caveatZh: 体素表示与足够的内部空间是前提；薄结构不一定具有足够的阻挡与形块复用机会。 仍需考虑块间应力集中及更大尺度应用。 图保证的是所建模方向内的几何互锁；两件打印检验不能外推到载荷谱、加工间隙或材料强度认证。 本轮未确认该论文的公开实现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 用重复原语和互锁顺序共同优化覆盖，是组装式生成、重复模具和积木结构可直接参考的规划问题；当前方法生成自定义形块。
